candidate_review.finding: V12 spec explicitly requires get() to return a detached deep copy, but the V12 exact candidate plus its recorded fixup still returns self._items[...] directly.

reproduction.method: offline Python harness against the exact get()/ConversationSegment behavior from blob 553bd349... with external modules stubbed; no provider traffic

fix.change: item = self._items.get(...); return copy.deepcopy(item) if item is not None else None

risk: If server-side preparation mutates a segment returned by get() before strict publication, the in-memory preimage is already altered. A later NCM28 write failure can therefore leave memory inconsistent with the last durable state and weaken V12 rollback guarantees.
